license_required.quote: A person may not practice medicine, podiatry, or osteopathy in the state unless the person is licensed under this chapter

degree_required.value: graduation from a legally chartered school of podiatry approved by the board
degree_required.quote: submit a certificate of graduation from a legally chartered school of podiatry approved by the board

exams.name: Board examination in subjects the board considers necessary
exams.notes: A podiatrist of known ability assists in the examination
exams.quote: take the examination required by AS 08.64.210; the board shall call to its aid a podiatrist of known ability who is licensed to practice podiatry to assist in the examination and licensure of applicants for a license to practice podiatry

interval_years.quote: the fee for a permit issued under this section is one-fourth of the fee for a biennial license

required.quote: requiring every licensee of medicine, osteopathy, and podiatry in the state to fulfill continuing education requirements

period_years.quote: not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license

value: pain management and opioid use and addiction (minimum 2 hours per 2-year renewal period)
topical_requirements.quote: Continuing education requirements must include not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license

available.quote: the board may waive the examination requirement and license by credentials if the physician, osteopath, or podiatry applicant meets the requirements of AS 08.64.200, 08.64.205, or 08.64.209, submits proof of continued competence as required by regulation, pays the required fee, and has an active license from a board of medical examiners established under the laws of a state or territory of the United States or a province or territory of Canada issued after thorough examination

requirements.value: Active license from a board of medical examiners in a US state/territory or Canadian province/territory issued after thorough examination, plus proof of continued competence and required fee
requirements.quote: the board may waive the examination requirement and license by credentials if the physician, osteopath, or podiatry applicant meets the requirements of AS 08.64.200, 08.64.205, or 08.64.209, submits proof of continued competence as required by regulation, pays the required fee, and has an active license from a board of medical examiners established under the laws of a state or territory of the United States or a province or territory of Canada issued after thorough examination

regulatory_model.quote: A person may not practice medicine, podiatry, or osteopathy in the state unless the person is licensed under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice medicine, podiatry, or osteopathy in the state unless the person is licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Secured a license through deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: secured a license through deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation while providing professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in deceit, fraud, or intentional misrepresentation while providing professional services or engaging in professional activities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised professional services in a false or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertised professional services in a false or misleading manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a class A or unclassified felony, a related class B or C felony, or a crime involving unlawful drug procurement/sale/prescription/dispensing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted, including conviction based on a guilty plea or plea of nolo contendere, of a class A or unclassified felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of a law regardless of whether there has been a criminal action or harm to the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally or negligently permitted patient care by supervised persons that does not conform to minimum professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentionally or negligently permitted the performance of patient care by persons under the licensee's supervision that does not conform to minimum professional standards even if the patient was not injured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with the chapter, a regulation adopted under it, or an order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed to comply with this chapter, a regulation adopted under this chapter, or an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated professional incompetence, gross negligence, or repeated negligent conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: professional incompetence, gross negligence, or repeated negligent conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to, severe dependency on, or habitual overuse of alcohol or other drugs that impairs ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: addiction to, severe dependency on, or habitual overuse of alcohol or other drugs that impairs the licensee's ability to practice safely

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfitness because of physical or mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unfitness because of physical or mental disability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional conduct, sexual misconduct, or lewd or immoral conduct in connection with delivery of professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in unprofessional conduct, in sexual misconduct, or in lewd or immoral conduct in connection with the delivery of professional services to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any code of ethics adopted by regulation by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has violated any code of ethics adopted by regulation by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denied care or treatment to a patient solely because the patient refused to agree to arbitrate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has denied care or treatment to a patient or person seeking assistance from the physician if the only reason for the denial is the failure or refusal of the patient to agree to arbitrate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license or certificate to practice medicine in another jurisdiction denied, suspended, revoked, or otherwise adversely acted upon
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had a license or certificate to practice medicine in another state or territory of the United States, or a province or territory of Canada, denied, suspended, revoked, surrendered while under investigation for an alleged violation, restricted, limited, conditioned, or placed on probation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized under AS 08.64.363

definition_quote.value: the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot, and superficial lesions of the hand other than those associated with trauma; the use of preparations, medicines, and drugs as are necessary for the treatment of these ailments; the treatment of the local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear in the hand and foot
definition_quote.quote: "practice of podiatry" means the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot, and superficial lesions of the hand other than those associated with trauma; the use of preparations, medicines, and drugs as are necessary for the treatment of these ailments; the treatment of the local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear in the hand and foot

methods_authorized.quote: the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot

drug_authority.value: Use of preparations, medicines, and drugs as necessary for treatment of podiatric ailments
drug_authority.quote: the use of preparations, medicines, and drugs as are necessary for the treatment of these ailments

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the medical, mechanical, and surgical treatment of ailments of the foot, the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: general anaesthetics may be used only in colleges of podiatry approved by the board and in hospitals approved by the joint commission on the accreditation of hospitals, or the American Osteopathic Association

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: a patient shall be concurrently referred to a physician or osteopath for the treatment of the systemic disease itself

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: the treatment of the local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear in the hand and foot

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: The board shall adopt regulations authorizing a physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant licensed under this chapter to delegate routine medical duties to an agent of the physician, podiatrist, osteopath, or physician assistant.

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: A licensee may not issue an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: Continuing education requirements must include not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: contract with private professional organizations to establish an impaired medical professionals program to identify, confront, evaluate, and treat persons licensed under this chapter who abuse alcohol, other drugs, or other substances or are mentally ill or cognitively impaired
